# Customer Self-Service Portal — Detailed Requirements

This document expands the requirements overview into individual, numbered functional requirements for the insurer's customer self-service portal, grouped by theme.

## FR-1: Requirement covering single sign-on against the insurer's Microsoft 365 tenant

Requirement FR-1 addresses single sign-on against the insurer's Microsoft 365 tenant. The portal must support this capability for all registered users, with behaviour that is consistent across desktop and mobile browsers. Acceptance for this requirement depends on sign-off from both the insurer's product owner and its compliance team, since it touches customer data. BISTEC's default stack should be used wherever it satisfies this requirement, to keep the tight budget and the .NET team's existing skills in mind. Edge cases, error states, and audit trail expectations for this requirement are captured in the accompanying test plan, iteration 1.
